author: Kyberlex <kyberlex@proton.me>
zero_biometrics_declaration: This telemetry register map is strictly restricted to abiotic electrical and thermal physics. No camera, audio, or biometric telemetry registers are permitted.

registers.name: PACK_CURRENT_DA
registers.description: Battery pack current (Positive = Charging, Negative = Discharging)

registers.name: STATE_OF_CHARGE
registers.description: Estimated State of Charge based on Coulomb counting and OCV

registers.name: STATE_OF_HEALTH
registers.description: State of Health based on cumulative cycle throughput

registers.name: TEMP_CELL_MIN
registers.description: Minimum cell temperature. Triggers hardware charge lockout if <= 2.0°C

registers.name: TEMP_CELL_MAX
registers.description: Maximum cell temperature. Triggers over-temperature cutoff if >= 55.0°C

registers.name: ALARM_STATUS_WORD_1
registers.description: Bit 0: Cell OVP, Bit 1: Cell UVP, Bit 2: Pack OVP, Bit 3: Pack UVP, Bit 4: Charge OTP, Bit 5: Charge UTP (Cryo lockout), Bit 6: Discharge OTP, Bit 7: Overcurrent Charge

registers.name: BALANCING_STATUS_WORD
registers.description: Bits 0-15: Individual active balancing state for cells 1 through 16
